attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (Illinois State Medical Board)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 60 hours formal CME (programs conducted/endorsed by hospitals, specialty societies, medical/osteopathic schools, board certification/recertification programs, approved sponsors; up to 12.5 h per month of postgraduate training); up to 90 hours informal (online searching, consultation, teaching, writing, self-assessment, peer review, etc.). AMA PRA certificate accepted as proof of the 150 hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal of an Illinois license, or after reinstatement to active status during the prerenewal period.
rules.carryover: CME used for one renewal cannot be used for another period.
rules.alternatives: Waiver for hardship (armed forces service, incapacitating illness, undue hardship) requested before the renewal date. Out-of-state CME accepted if approved by that jurisdiction.
rules.audit_note: Licensees keep their own completion records; the Division may require evidence (e.g. certificates).

topics.who: All licensees; counts toward CE hours
Physicians (medical and osteopathic); counts toward CE hours
Physicians; from first renewal on or after Jan 1, 2025, repeated once every 6 years
Only physicians with direct patient interaction with adults aged 26+; repeated once every 6 years

rules.notes: One license type for MDs and DOs. Prerenewal period = 36 months before July 31 of the renewal year (2026 deadline extended to Aug 31, 2026 by variance). Opioid prescribing CE for controlled substance licensees and mandated-reporter training not confirmed on official pages read.
